in_sanskrit.name: Pradip
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who illuminates, radiates, or removes darkness

in_marathi.name: Pradipsinh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the path
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pradipsinh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Pradipsinh is a compound name derived from two words: Pradi and Singh. Pradi means 'path' or 'journey', and Singh means 'lion' or 'king'. Therefore, Pradipsinh can be interpreted as 'Lord of the path' or 'King of the journey'.
